LanguageData.WVC_GeneResurgentTooltip: The <color=#8a8ae6>Resurgent</color> gene slowly accumulates <color=#8a8ae6>cells</color> (hediff) in the pawn. <color=#8a8ae6>Cells</color> decrease automatically, by <color=#8a8ae6>1 each day</color>, and <color=#8a8ae6>disappear</color> when they reach 0. Losing the gene <color=#8a8ae6>does not remove accumulated cells</color>. <color=#8a8ae6>Cells</color> are used by subgenes, or subgenes can be directly dependent on them.\n\n<color=#8a8ae6>Resurgent</color> can turn subgenes on and off at any time. This will increase <color=#8a8ae6>cell accumulation</color> relative to how many cells the subgene <color=#8a8ae6>passively</color> consumes. If an active subgene accumulates cells, turning it off will begin consuming them.
LanguageData.WVC_GeneResurgent_CreateSkeletonDesc: Using archites, create a \<color=#8a8ae6>skeleton duplicate</color> of the owner from cells. These duplicates are mindless workers who inherit the skills of their originals and can perform virtually any task without restrictions. However, they are unsuitable as fighters and work very slowly.\n\nCreating one <color=#8a8ae6>skeleton</color> requires 100 cells.
